links.title: Chapter 15 - Google Sheets, Automate the Boring Stuff with Python, 3rd Ed
links.why: The course textbook's own chapter, free online: set-up, Spreadsheet and Sheet objects, Google Forms, Project 11 and the quota section.

links.title: EZSheets - documentation
links.why: The library's own documentation: installation, the credentials and token file names, and the IGNORE_QUOTA name.

links.title: Usage limits - Google Sheets API
links.why: Google's current per-minute quotas for reads and writes, the HTTP 429 answer and the advice on exponential backoff.

links.title: Choose Google Sheets API scopes
links.why: Which scope is sensitive, restricted or non-sensitive, and why the narrowest scope that works is recommended.

links.title: Python quickstart - Google Sheets API
links.why: Google's own Python walk-through of the consent screen, the desktop credentials file and the token.json file.

links.title: Configure the OAuth consent screen and choose scopes
links.why: The consent screen steps in Google's current console: user type, scopes and test users.

links.title: ValueInputOption - Google Sheets API reference
links.why: What RAW and USER_ENTERED mean for a value a script writes into a cell.

links.title: Boringcoin (no backup, please do not delete) - Google Sheets
links.why: The public ledger of Project 11, three columns of sender, recipient and amount, that the audit program reads.

links.title: Bean Count (DO NOT DELETE) - Google Sheets
links.why: The public sheet of practice program 3: 15000 rows of beans per jar, jars and total beans, one of them wrong.

links.title: pickle - Python object serialization
links.why: The warning that the pickle module is not secure, which is why a token file must be kept private.

links.title: Built-in Types (dict.setdefault, tuples)
links.why: How setdefault creates an account at 0, and why a tuple of sheet titles cannot be changed in place.

links.title: shlex - Simple lexical analysis
links.why: shlex.split shows how a shell splits a command line, so why a name with a space needs quotes.
